scoring_justification: Recompute average deintercalation potential from voltage CSV; structural and migration compared to paper-reported references with tolerances.

hidden_assets.purpose: Hidden gold values for average voltage, structural properties, and migration barrier.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper 'Evaluating bulk Nb2O2F3 for Li-battery electrode applications' (DOI: 10.1039/c5cp06829k). Average deintercalation potential 1.29 V from abstract/voltage analysis; volume expansion 5%, interlayer distances 3.97/4.97 Å from text; band gap 1.0 eV from DOS; migration barrier 0.79 eV from cNEB results.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from paper's text, tables, and figures.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the exact headline quantitative claims of the paper, traceable to specific sections.

outputs.description: Voltage profile of LixNb2O2F3 deintercalation; the checker re-derives the average voltage and verifies monotonic trend.
Volume expansion, band gap, and interlayer distances upon lithiation.

output_contract.notes: The hidden checker uses paper-reported values for the deintercalation average voltage, volume expansion, band gap, and migration barrier as reference. Tolerances are set to accommodate toolchain differences.

steps.description: Recompute average deintercalation voltage from CSV (weighted mean over x intervals) and compare to paper-reported 1.29 V; require monotonic decreasing V(x).
Check each structural/electronic property against paper-reported values. Volume expansion 5±1%, band gap 1.0±0.2 eV, interlayer distances 3.97/4.97±0.1 Å.
Activation energy must be close to paper-reported 0.79 eV (within ±0.1 eV) and pathway must be '01'.
